article_draft.description: Complete Draft 1 SEO article containing at least 1000 words of substantive article body content, normally targeting 1100 to 1400 words. Metadata, FAQs, CTA, quality review, and other schema fields do not count toward this requirement. Write a fully developed publication-ready article in clean Markdown with a strong introduction, detailed H2 sections, useful H3 subsections where appropriate, practical explanations, actionable guidance, supported cautions, and a conclusion. Each major section should contain developed paragraphs rather than brief summaries. Use the supplied search intent, Ubersuggest data, search-demand findings, People Also Ask questions, related searches, competitor gaps, unique content angle, recommended outline, and AI recommendation. Do not return an outline, synopsis, abbreviated article, or short overview. Do not create real-life success stories, case studies, expert claims, statistics, or factual examples unless they are supported by the supplied research. Clearly label illustrative examples as hypothetical. Do not include the final CTA inside article_draft because it is returned separately.

image_prompt.description: Create one detailed article-specific premium editorial photography prompt for The Black Jew Wealth Coach. The visual should communicate the specific article topic while reflecting Brandon Gardner's audience and brand themes such as Black entrepreneurship, financial education, ownership, investing, business growth, wealth building, or generational wealth when relevant. Prioritize authentic Black entrepreneurs, professionals, investors, business owners, families, or young people when appropriate to the article, while allowing natural diversity when context calls for it. Specify the subject, activity, environment, composition, wardrobe when applicable, lighting, mood, camera perspective, photographic style, and topic-specific visual details. Use authentic people, realistic activity, sophisticated contemporary environments, natural expressions, realistic skin tones, editorial lighting, visual depth, and a premium financial or entrepreneurial editorial aesthetic. Vary subjects, ages, genders, professions, settings, activities, and compositions across articles. Do not default to the same entrepreneur sitting at a laptop. Avoid generic stock-photo scenes, fake corporate handshakes, fake wealth imagery, piles of cash, raining money, oversized dollar signs, luxury cars or mansions unrelated to the topic, cartoon finance imagery, stereotypes, religious costumes or stereotypes, fake checks, unrealistic financial promises, logos, watermarks, headlines, or text embedded in the image.

image_alt_text.description: Concise, accessible alt text accurately describing the proposed featured image. Describe what is visually present and relevant to the article. Do not keyword stuff.

cta.description: Relevant, credible call to action connecting the reader with The Black Jew Wealth Coach, Brandon Gardner, or an appropriate supplied service or resource. The CTA should fit the article naturally and must not guarantee funding, credit improvement, investment returns, wealth, or other financial outcomes.
